definitions.field_accuracy: Correct checked proposals / known fact-sheet slots; omissions fail. Child IDs are ignored, but full name/date values must match as a multiset.
definitions.citation_accuracy: Supported raw assertion groups / all raw assertion groups, including earlier and uncertain claims. Each group must satisfy the strict fact/assertion/citation structure. Exact quotes must exist on their cited lines and jointly contain the value words in order. This measures literal containment, not whether the caller asserted the value as a fact. Malformed claim entries count as failures; unparseable whole outputs have zero groups and are listed separately.
definitions.missing_fact_review_rate: Unresolved fact-sheet slots with no usable proposal and an empty pending review row / all unresolved slots. Reserve empty child rows for unmatched known children first; remaining rows can cover unresolved children only when no unmatched usable child proposal exists.
definitions.escaped_guess_rate: Incorrect checked proposals / all checked proposals, including invented, stale, misattributed, and duplicate values. This is before mandatory human approval, not a rate of incorrect released drafts.
definitions.normalization: Unicode word tokens after case folding; punctuation and whitespace are ignored. No semantic model judge or post-hoc aliases.
